meta.title: Draxuvo · Technology and automation
meta.description: A system for small businesses in Mexico: staff, attendance, inventory, work orders, tickets and reports. You only pay for the modules in your plan.

hero.title: Your whole business in one system
hero.subtitle: Staff, attendance, inventory, work orders, tickets and reports in one panel. You only pay for the modules in your plan.
hero.trialNote: 30 days free, no card required. Cancel anytime.

modules.title: What each module does
modules.subtitle: Each module handles one part of your operation. Your plan says which ones you get.

employees.title: Staff
employees.desc: Records, positions and salaries for your team in one place.
employees.problem: Your team's details live in notebooks, chats and loose sheets, and when you need a phone number or a salary nobody knows where it is.
features: A record per person with position, area, salary, email and phone
Active and inactive employees, with search
Check-in and check-out from each employee's record

examples.restaurant: Waiters, cooks and dishwashers with their position and salary, ready for payroll.
examples.cafe: Baristas on every shift with their phone at hand to cover absences.
examples.services: Electricians and helpers with their area, so you know who to send.

attendance.title: Attendance
attendance.desc: Check-ins, check-outs, late arrivals and absences logged daily.
attendance.problem: You don't know who arrived late or how many absences there were this month until someone complains or payroll comes due.
features: Today's records marked on time, late or absent
Filters by date range, employee and type
Today's attendance summary on the dashboard

examples.restaurant: See whether the kitchen is fully staffed before the lunch service.
examples.cafe: Check the morning shift's late arrivals without being behind the counter.
examples.services: Know which technicians arrived before handing out the day's orders.

inventory.title: Inventory
inventory.desc: Products, stock levels and incoming and outgoing movements.
inventory.problem: You find out something ran out when a customer asks for it, and the count lives in one person's memory.
features: Products with SKU, cost, price and minimum stock
Stock in and out with a note, plus low stock and out of stock alerts
Product upload from a template

examples.restaurant: Know which supplies are running low before ordering from your supplier.
examples.cafe: Milk, coffee beans and cups with their minimum, to restock on time.
examples.services: Cable, outlets and bulbs with their stock, and when you build an order you pick the material from inventory.

work_orders.title: Work orders
work_orders.desc: Assign, track and close every job with its details.
work_orders.problem: Jobs come in by phone, get written down wherever, and nobody knows how each one is going or who has it.
features: An order with assignee, priority, date and task list
Statuses from pending to completed, with filters by status, priority and employee
Order line items taken from inventory, with their price

examples.restaurant: Hood maintenance or a fridge repair, with a date and someone in charge.
examples.cafe: Espresso machine service with its tasks and who does it.
examples.services: Every installation or repair with its technician, its tasks and the material from inventory.

tickets.title: Tickets
tickets.desc: Bill each finished order with a folio and a PDF ready to send.
tickets.problem: You finish the job and billing is left hanging: you don't know what is paid and what is still owed.
features: A ticket generated from the finished order, with folio and line items
PDF download to send to the customer
Pending and paid, with what was collected and what is still owed

examples.restaurant: Bill an event or a delivery service with its PDF ticket.
examples.cafe: Bill office orders and see which ones are still pending.
examples.services: When the order is closed, the ticket comes out with the line items to bill the customer.

reports.title: Reports
reports.desc: Income, expenses and payroll to decide with data.
reports.problem: At the end of the month you don't know how much came in, how much went out or what payroll cost without doing the math by hand.
features: Income, expenses and payroll by period
Weekly, monthly or annual view with a date range
A summary alongside the period's attendance

examples.restaurant: Compare each month's income against what you paid in payroll.
examples.cafe: See which weeks sold the most and how much you spent in them.
examples.services: Know how much you billed this year and how much went to wages.

whatsapp.title: WhatsApp
whatsapp.desc: Send tickets to your customers on WhatsApp.
whatsapp.problem: Sending every ticket by hand, looking up the customer's number on your phone, eats time and sometimes gets forgotten.
features: Send the ticket by WhatsApp from its screen
The customer's number is entered when sending
Resend the same ticket when needed

examples.restaurant: An event customer gets their ticket in the chat they already use.
examples.cafe: Send an office order's ticket without leaving the panel.
examples.services: The customer gets the job's ticket as soon as the technician finishes.

multi_company.title: Multiple companies
multi_company.desc: Several companies or branches in one account.
multi_company.problem: If you run more than one business or branch, you end up with a different system for each one.
features: Several companies or branches in one account
Each company with its own data, kept apart from the others
Included in the Enterprise plan

examples.restaurant: Two branches of the same restaurant, each with its own staff and inventory.
examples.cafe: The café and the stand at the mall, with their data kept apart.
examples.services: The installation company and the maintenance company in the same account.

artAlt.employees: Staff cards lining up one after another
artAlt.tickets: Ticket printing with its line items
artAlt.multi_company: Two branches connected to one account

pro.name: Pro

enterprise.name: Enterprise
enterprise.desc: Everything in Pro plus WhatsApp and several companies or branches in one account

asistencia.caption: Today's attendance: who arrived on time, late or was absent.

suscripcion.caption: Subscription: your plan, the total with VAT and the modules you have turned on.

closing.title: Know which plan fits you?
closing.subtitle: Create your account, pick the plan and use everything free for 30 days. No card required.

flow.title: From job to payment in five steps
flow.subtitle: Move forward and back with the buttons, the arrow keys or by swiping.
flow.region: Demo of the flow from a work order to a paid ticket

pending.title: The order arrives
pending.desc: You log the job with client, priority and date. It stays pending.

progress.title: It is assigned and starts
progress.desc: You pick who is responsible and the order moves to in progress.

items.title: You add the line items
items.desc: Labor and inventory material, with their price. The total is calculated for you.

done.title: It is completed
done.desc: The technician finishes and the order is ready to charge.

paid.title: Ticket paid
paid.desc: The ticket comes out with a number and a PDF, marked as paid.
